privacy_intro: Mosmos collects only the minimum information below, for waitlist registration.
privacy_purpose: To share launch news and the first invitation
privacy_consent: Without consent we don't store anything. You can withdraw consent at any time — contact us if you'd like your registration removed.
privacy_optional: Survey answers such as your role and current AI tasks are optional, and are used only to set the order of first invitations.
survey_intro: Want an earlier invite? 30 seconds more — what you tell us sets the order.
survey_job_label: What kind of work do you do?
survey_ai_label: What do you mostly use AI for these days?
survey_job_other_label: Other — what kind of work do you do?
survey_task_other_label: Other — tell us what kind of task
survey_done: Thank you. We'll keep this in mind.
confirm_title:
You're in.
We'll send your invitation from the front of the line.
confirm_email_sent: We sent a welcome email — take a look in your inbox.
confirm_care: We're inviting a small group at a time. We want to hear each person's story properly.
confirm_next: From here, we'll send you notes from the build now and then.
confirm_world_tagline: Another me, in the digital world
confirm_mos_line: I've remembered your name. You'll be the first one I call.
founder_note: Hi — I'm building Mosmos. I'll handle the first invitations personally, one at a time, and I'd rather share the process honestly than show you a finished picture.
recruit_title: Want to build Mosmos as an early member?
recruit_text: If you're curious, take a look.
recruit_cta: See how to join the early team
meta_title: mosmos — a world where my AI grows up
meta_description: Just say it. Mos does the moving. A personal AI for people who research, organise and write things up. We invite the front row first.
hero_tagline: A world where my AI grows up
hero_sub: Just say it. Mos does the moving.
hero_gloss: Mos — the AI companion that settles the goal with you and brings back the result
hero_anchor: A personal AI for people who research, organise and write things up
mos_poke_2: That tickles. Shall we get started?
mos_poke_4: Leave your name and I'll remember it.
ache: If getting AI to do the work became work of its own
decide_lead: Then I hand it to the right specialist and bring the result back. Pick one.
decide_g1: Tell me only what changed in competitors' pricing this week
decide_g2: Pull just the decisions out of yesterday's minutes
decide_g3: Point out the risky clauses in this contract
decide_ask2: Should I match owners to them?
decide_hand: I'll hand this to the right specialist.
decide_r1: Two of six pricing pages changed. Only the changed rows are in the table.
decide_r2: Four decisions pulled out. One on hold, carried to the next meeting.
decide_r3: Three high-risk clauses flagged, each with wording to use instead.
decide_note: Light work Mos does on the spot; heavy work a Mon takes on its own. You are charged after the run, for what it used.
watch_title: Say it once and it keeps watching
watch_lead: Write what to watch for as a sentence. If there is nothing worth saying, it stays quiet.
watch_memo_hint: Shorter is better · patrolling itself costs no Mana
watch_memo_1: Tell me if Mana drops below 200
watch_memo_2: Tell me if something urgent lands in my inbox
watch_memo_3: Summarise new comments on the shared docs
watch_memo_4: Give me a short note if a competitor page changes
watch_add: Write one line to watch for
watch_beat_state: Patrols every 30 min · quiet right now
watch_cron_lead: Work that needs a fixed time gets booked here
watch_cron_1_m: Daily 08:00 · sent to Chat · about Mana 12
watch_cron_3_m: Mondays 09:00 · sent to Chat · about Mana 13
watch_note: These run at the time you set. Anything without a natural time belongs to the patrol.
make_lead: Plug parts into the core. No code involved. Try plugging one in.
make_tier_hint: Picking one changes the estimate per run
make_tier_1_d: Short sorting and tidying, very fast.
make_tier_2_d: Speed and accuracy in balance for most document work.
make_tier_3_d: Pushes hard judgement and evidence all the way.
make_note: Building has no plan gate. It is open on every plan.
share_title: Put what you built on the Hub
share_lead: Someone else's Mos picks it up when it fits their goal. You set the price.
share_free_d: The Patron pays token cost only
share_listed: HOW IT LOOKS ON THE HUB
share_mine_desc: Flags risk per clause and suggests wording to use instead.
share_review_mos: Mos reviews — completion, format adherence and recall rate, left by the Mos that actually delegated
share_note: A paid Mon is charged after the run. Only a Mon Skill is a single purchase.
cost_title: A place to stay, and the power to run
cost_lead: The subscription decides where you stay; Mana turns the work over. Neither replaces the other.
cost_sub_d: Monthly access, storage, scheduled runs, queue position
cost_p1_role: Come in and finish a first task
cost_p2_role: Run it daily, with scheduling and patrols
cost_p3_role: Run it wide, with a priority queue
cost_mana_d: Sits in an account and goes down as you use it · put in only what you need
cost_compare: A subscription cap resets on a clock; leftover Mana simply carries over
cost_compare_ref: For the same money — Claude Pro 45 per 5 h · ChatGPT Plus 160 per 3 h
cost_note: These figures are still under review. We'll say so when they settle.
join_title: As soon as it's ready, the front row hears first
join_scarcity: The pilot goes out to a small, selected group.
trust_care: Your email is used only for launch and pilot news, and notes from the build.
world_island_label: The sky island Mos lives on
